item.text: I’ll rerun the existing successful manifest exactly as stored, record a new run without touching prior evidence, verify the same two JSON assertions independently, and compare the successful manifest’s SHA-256 before and after. No manifest or step will be regenerated.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "set -e
manifest='.qf/service-readiness/service-readiness.yaml'
evidence='.qf/service-readiness/evidence'
runner='.qf/tools/qloops-0.2.0-core.11/package/bin/qloop.mjs'
repeat_out=\""'$evidence/repeat-run.txt"
repeat_record="$evidence/repeat-run-record.json"
repeat_check="$evidence/repeat-independent-check.txt"
test ! -e "$repeat_out"
test ! -e "$repeat_record"
test ! -e "$repeat_check"
before=$(shasum -a 256 "$manifest" | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
node \""'$runner" run "$manifest" --json > "$repeat_out"
run_id=$(sed -n '"'/"'^{/,$p'"' \""'$repeat_out" | jq -r '"'.runId')
test -n \""'$run_id" && test "$run_id" != null
cp ".qf/service-readiness/.qf/runs/$run_id.json" "$repeat_record"
node .qf/service-readiness/verify-service-readiness.mjs success "$repeat_record" > "$repeat_check"
after=$(shasum -a 256 "$manifest" | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
test \""'$before" = "$after"
{
  printf '"'manifest=%s\\n' \""'$manifest"
  printf '"'sha256_before=%s\\n' \""'$before"
  printf '"'sha256_after=%s\\n' \""'$after"
  printf '"'unchanged=%s\\n' \""'$([ "$before" = "$after" ] && echo true || echo false)"
  printf '"'run_id=%s\\n' \""'$run_id"
} > "$evidence/repeat-manifest-hash-comparison.txt"
cat "$repeat_check"
cat "$evidence/repeat-manifest-hash-comparison.txt"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- repeated output summary ---'
jq '{runId,status,summary,steps:[.steps[]|{stepId,status,http:.output.status,json:.output.json}]}' \""'$repeat_record"'
